newsitem.title: USA: CORESTAFF closes on note, shr offering.
newsitem.headline: CORESTAFF closes on note, shr offering.

text.p: CORESTAFF Inc said on Monday it has completed separate stock and debt offerings.

The company raised $187.9 million from an offering of $230 million in face value of 2.94 percent convertible subordinated notes due 2004, which were issued at an original price of 83.991 percent of the principal amount at maturity, CORESTAFF said in a statement.
The interest rate on the notes, together with the original issue discount, represent a yield to maturity of 5.75 percent per annum.
CORESTAFF said proceeds from the debt offering will be used to repay a portion of the company's credit facility.
The notes will be convertible into shares of CORESTAFF common stock at a conversion rate of 23.7397 shares per $1,000 in principal amount of the notes, CORESTAFF said.
Concurrently with the sale of the notes, certain stockholders of CORESTAFF sold an aggregate 6.9 million shares of CORESTAFF common stock for $29 a share, the company said.

The notes were underwritten by Morgan Stanley Dean Witter, Goldman, Sachs & Co, Alex. Brown & Sons Inc, Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp, Montgomery Securities and Robinson-Humphrey Co Inc, the company said.

The common stock offering in the United States and Canada was managed by the same underwriters as the notes offering and the international offering of the common stock was managed by Morgan Stanley Dean Witter, Goldman Sachs International, Alex. Brown & Sons Inc, Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette International, Montgomery Securities and The Robinson- Humphrey Co Inc.
